# gitmoap_group_sso_connection (Data Source)

Read the organization's single sign-on connection. Its protocol, status, attribute mapping, verified domains and sign-in policy, with the last setup error if there was one. Secrets are never returned, only whether an OpenID Connect client secret or a SAML metadata document is set; a disabled connection reads as `disabled`. Only the organization's owners can read it.

The token needs `sso:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The organization's top-level group

### Read-Only

- `attribute_mapping` (Attributes) Which identity-provider claim or attribute supplies each gitmoap field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attribute_mapping))
- `auto_provision` (Boolean)
- `cognito_idp_name` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (Attributes) Who did something — a person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — with what a
client needs to draw and link them, so a page of records names its actors without a lookup each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--created_by))
- `default_role` (Attributes) A role — built in or defined by the organization — with its display name and the built-in rank
it counts as. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_role))
- `enforced` (Boolean)
- `idp_sync_max_age_days` (Number) Days a place on a team linked to an identity-provider group lasts without the person signing
in again.
- `last_provision_error` (String)
- `last_test` (Attributes) The outcome of a connection's last test, who ran it and when. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--last_test))
- `oidc` (Attributes) A connection's OIDC settings. The client secret is never returned, only whether one is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc))
- `protocol` (String) The IdP protocol an org's connection speaks.
- `root_group_id` (String)
- `saml` (Attributes) A connection's SAML settings. The metadata document itself is never returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml))
- `status` (String) Where an organization's SSO connection is in being set up. A connection left `provisioning` or
`failed` is retried by saving the connection again.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `verified_domains` (List of String)

<a id="nestedatt--attribute_mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attribute_mapping`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The claim or attribute carrying the person's email address. Defaults to `email`.
- `groups` (String) The claim listing the person's groups at the identity provider, if any. Teams linked to
those groups follow it.
- `username` (String) The claim a new account's username is derived from, if any.


<a id="nestedatt--created_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `created_by`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) The principal's picture, when one is known. Absent otherwise: a client derives the
deterministic avatar URL itself.
- `email` (String) The principal's address. An agent's is a generated no-reply address — the author of its
commits. `unknown` on a deleted actor and empty on a redacted one.
- `id` (String) The principal's id: a user id, a service account id or an agent id, as `kind` says. Empty on
a redacted actor.
- `kind` (String) A person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — which of the three a principal is,
and so which page it links to: a person's profile, a service account's page or an agent's page.
- `username` (String) The name to show: a person's or service account's username, or an agent's handle (which
always ends in `-ai`). `deleted-user` when the actor no longer resolves, `redacted` when the
caller may not see who it was. A closed account whose work stays is `closed-` and twelve hex
digits, a shape no open account may take, with an address under `.invalid`.


<a id="nestedatt--default_role"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_role`

Read-Only:

- `builtin` (String)
- `custom` (String)
- `name` (String) The role's display name: a built-in name such as `Developer`, or the custom role's name.
- `rank` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--last_test"></a>
### Nested Schema for `last_test`

Read-Only:

- `at` (String) When it ran.
- `by` (Attributes) Who did something — a person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — with what a
client needs to draw and link them, so a page of records names its actors without a lookup each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--last_test--by))
- `ok` (Boolean) Whether every check passed.
